title: Ultrasound for Small Animal Imaging
author: Yves Sauve
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.u83ezyn

steps.title: Record Animal Details
steps.instruction: Record the specific details of the animal used for experiments on each report, including weight, date of birth (DOB), sex, and strain.

steps.title: Induce Anesthesia
steps.instruction: Induce total anesthesia for knockdown using an induction chamber.

substeps.instruction: Set oxygen level to 1-1.5L/minute.
Set Isoflurane to 1%, followed by incremental increases of 0.5% up to 3.0%.
Confirm induction via pedal response.

steps.title: Maintain Anesthesia and Immobilization
steps.instruction: Transition the animal to maintenance anesthesia and move to the handling platform.

substeps.instruction: Redirect Isoflurane through the hose to the mask.
Set maintenance Isoflurane levels: 1.5-2.0% for obese animals or 1.0-1.5% for lean animals.
Move the animal to the animal handling platform with the snout in the anesthesia mask.
Monitor anesthesia level via pedal response to ensure the animal remains immobilized.

steps.title: Prepare Animal for Monitoring
steps.instruction: Apply lubricants and attach monitoring equipment.

substeps.instruction: Apply a small amount of corneal lubricant to each eye using a sterile cotton tip applicator.
Place a drop of gel onto each ECG connector on the handling platform.
Secure contact pads with dermatological 3M tape.
Use the ECG threshold control to adjust the display of ECG, heart rate, and respiration on screen.

steps.title: Prepare Imaging Area
steps.instruction: Clear hair from the area of interest and apply ultrasound gel.

substeps.instruction: Shave the area of interest.
Apply depilatory cream to remove remaining hair.
Remove cream after 1 minute with a water wash and pat dry.
Heat ultrasound gel to 37°C using a gel warmer.
Place the warmed ultrasound gel on the area of interest.
Clean and disinfect the rectal probe.
Cover the probe with lubricating gel.
Slowly advance the probe 3-5mm into the rectum.
Secure the probe with 3M tape.

steps.title: Position Ultrasound Scanhead
steps.instruction: Set up and align the imaging hardware.

substeps.instruction: Attach the Scanhead to the rail system and mount it above the animal.
Move the animal handling platform and the Scanhead to attain the correct position for the area of interest.
Use the Vevo monitor controls to bring the area of interest into view.

steps.title: Perform Imaging Session
steps.instruction: Conduct the imaging procedure while monitoring physiological parameters.

substeps.instruction: Perform the imaging session (typically takes 10-30 minutes depending on required views).
Closely monitor and record physiological parameters alongside the images.

steps.title: Post-Imaging Cleanup and Recovery
steps.instruction: Remove equipment and transition the animal to recovery.

substeps.instruction: Remove ultrasound gel from the animal.
Clean the shaved area with a warm damp gauze and pat dry.
Carefully remove the temperature probe and the tape securing the animal to the platform.
Turn off the anesthetic and remove the nose from the mask.

steps.title: Final Recording and Recovery
steps.instruction: Weigh the animal and monitor recovery until stable.

substeps.instruction: Weigh the animal on a scale and record the weight.
Place the animal in an incubation chamber with O2 until complete recovery is obtained (approx. 1-3 min), indicated by righting reflex and ability to eat, drink, and walk.
Place the animal back into its home cage after complete recovery.

steps.title: Decontaminate Equipment
steps.instruction: Clean and disinfect all used surfaces and hardware.

substeps.instruction: Clean Scanheads and ECG platform with T-Spray disinfectant.
Clean the box, fume-hood surface, counter, and weigh scales with Virkon solution.
Rinse Virkon-treated surfaces with water after 10 minutes.
